description:
Settle the market NO, permissionlessly, once the close height has passed.

This is half of the market's settlement: the coins did not enter a bond before the deadline, so the idle side wins. Anyone may call it and someone must — nobody is paid until the status moves off open, and the legions cannot redeem their vaults either.

It pays the caller nothing and costs them gas. Moves no assets. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.
name: atstake_resolve_idle
